description.value: Backeddy Resort and Marina is a remote, award-winning waterfront resort on BC's Sunshine Coast, set along 600 feet of shoreline on the Sechelt Inlet near Egmont and the Skookumchuck Narrows Provincial Park. The property encompasses twenty varied accommodation units — from modern waterfront cabins to geodesic glamping domes and vintage A-frames — alongside a full-service marina, an oceanfront pub, and an on-site rental fleet including mountain bikes. Its location makes it a natural base for cyclists exploring the upper Sunshine Coast, with hiking, ocean kayaking, and wildlife viewing immediately accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the resort is actively operating with current promotions and seasonal events. The amenities page explicitly lists mountain bike rentals, 24-hour coin-operated laundry in the marina washhouse, and an on-site pub serving food — but makes no mention of secure bike storage for guest-owned bikes or staff bike procedures. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by any website mention of Wi-Fi, so that amenity is left null per the rules.
concerns: Website contact page lists a local number (604) 883-2298 not present in OSM tags; OSM only records the toll-free 1-800-626-0599. Both numbers appear current and valid.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating resort with multiple accommodation types, on-site food, laundry, and bike rentals — clearly useful to touring cyclists visiting the upper Sunshine Coast.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort operates mountain bike rentals (listed on the amenities page), which may be of interest to touring cyclists who need a loaner or spare. No evidence of secure storage for guest-owned bikes was found.
